name: Aquila And Priscilla
overview: The Scriptures introduce Aquila and Priscilla as faithful Christian tentmakers who partnered closely with Paul during his ministry in Corinth and Ephesus. After Paul arrived in Corinth, he met this couple, recently expelled from Rome, and worked alongside them in their shared craft. Their friendship with Paul is marked by mutual support, as seen when Paul traveled with them to Syria and left them in Ephesus, where they played a key role in instructing a new believer more accurately in the way of God. Their example highlights the importance of partnership, hospitality, and teaching within the early church.
